# Implementation Plan: 北京儒泰分销管理后端与API

**Branch**: `001-distribution-management-api` | **Date**: 2026-07-30 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-distribution-management-api/spec.md`

**Note**: This file is generated by the `/speckit-plan` command.

## Summary

构建北京儒泰分销管理系统的后端API服务和管理后台前端。系统包含10个用户故事：微信登录认证、资质审核管理、客户绑定管理、层级体系管理、数据同步与贡献值计算、贡献值查看、分账规则配置、对账报表、科普内容CMS和推广码管理。技术栈采用Python FastAPI后端 + Vue 3 Vite管理后台 + MySQL 8.0数据库，严格遵循TDD原则。

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Python 3.11+ (backend), JavaScript/TypeScript (Vue 3 admin)
**Primary Dependencies**: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0+, Alembic, Pydantic v2, httpx, APScheduler, Vue 3, Vite, Element Plus, Pinia, Axios
**Storage**: MySQL 8.0 on Tencent Cloud (remote TLS connection)
**Testing**: pytest + pytest-asyncio (backend), Vitest + Vue Test Utils (admin)
**Target Platform**: Linux server (Docker), Web (Vue admin), WeChat Mini-Program (frontend exists)
**Project Type**: web-service + web-application (backend API + admin SPA)
**Performance Goals**: API p95 < 2s for main endpoints, reports < 60s generation, 500 concurrent promoters
**Constraints**: TDD mandatory (tests first), audit logs permanent retention, data masking on all list/detail endpoints, idempotency keys on write operations
**Scale/Scope**: 500+ promoters in 6-level hierarchy, 10k+ customers, sync polling every 60s, monthly settlement batch

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. TDD (NON-NEGOTIABLE) | ✅ PASS | All tasks will enforce test-first; pytest + Vitest configured; contract tests for all API endpoints |
| II. API-First Design | ✅ PASS | Backend API is the single data source; mini-program and Vue admin both consume APIs only; unified response format `{code, message, data, requestId, serverTime}` |
| III. Separation of Concerns | ✅ PASS | Three tiers: `backend/` (Python API), `admin/` (Vue+Vite SPA), `miniProgram/` (existing WeChat frontend); independently buildable |
| IV. Database Integrity | ✅ PASS | MySQL on Tencent Cloud via TLS; Alembic migrations; Pydantic validation; audit logging on all sensitive operations; no direct client DB access |
| V. Simplicity (YAGNI) | ✅ PASS | No repository pattern for single-DB; no microservices for single-team scope; straightforward module-per-domain organization; external deps justified per feature |

**Gate Result**: PASS — All constitutional principles satisfied. No violations to justify.
